experiment: Same release binary; temporary compiled cap 64. Production source remains cap 16. Alternating separate/multiplexed runs; all other agent builds held.
boundary: Engine plus blocking benchmark decoders; excludes producer CPU, GUI and SSH. One legacy stalled preview and one normal active attachment in both modes. Idle decoder uses 100ms deadline checks.
wire_byte_caveat: Separate decoder bytes include the initial seed; mux per-source bytes start after admission and include JSON envelopes. Do not use these counters as a like-for-like bandwidth comparison.
